name: Luban Chat
description: Run the Luban coding agent in a sidebar panel over ACP — no terminal, no borrowed agent slot.

settings.title: luban-acp command
settings.description: Command line that starts the ACP server. Empty = ~/.local/bin/luban-acp, else `luban-acp` on PATH.

settings.title: Model
settings.description: Model key passed as --model (see `luban --list-models`). Empty = whatever ~/.luban/config uses.

settings.title: Read-only (plan mode)
settings.description: Start the agent with --read-only: write tools and write commands are refused.
